L Ls n4 n5

rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints (NF and S21) by adding a source degeneration inductor in series with the NMOS’s source, enhancing noise performance and gain through improved impedance matching and reduced noise figure. The inductor resonates with the source capacitance at 2.44 GHz, increasing the effective source impedance and improving the transconductance-to-noise ratio without increasing power. This preserves the low current draw and maintains stability, while directly addressing the large negative margins in NF and S21.
